simple.meaning: מְהוּמָה (mᵉhûwmâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “confusion or uproar.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 12 times across Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 2 Chronicles, Proverbs, Isaiah, and 3 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 7:23. Its contexts include kingship, city, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְהוּמָה (H4103).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מְהוּמָה (mᵉhûwmâh) / H4103 is traced through Deuteronomy 7:23, Deuteronomy 28:20, 1 Samuel 5:9, 1 Samuel 5:11 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: destruction, discomfiture, trouble, tumult, vexation, vexed.
definitions.full: H4103. mehumah מְהוּמָה noun feminine tumult, confusion, disquietde, discomfiture — absolute ׳מ Deut 7:23 7 t.; construct מְהוּמַת 1Sam 5:11 ; Ezek 22:5 ; plural absolute מְהוּמוֺת 2Chr 15:5 , מְהוּמֹת Amos 3:9 ; — 1 tumult, confusion Amos 3:9 (|| עֲשׁוּקִים oppression ), disturbance, turmoil (opposed to peace) 2Chr 15:5 (|| verb המם 15:6 ), compare Ezek 22:5 ; disquietude (of mind) Prov 15:16 ; especially tumult & confusion, panic , as due to divine judgment ׳מְהוּמַתיֿ Zech 14:13 compare Ezek 7:7 ; also 1Sam 5:9 and מָוֶת מְהוּמַת 5:11 . 2 discomfiture , (due to ׳י ) in war 1Sam 14:20 (compare 14:15 ; 14:22 ); Deut 7:23 (accusative of congnate meaning with verb with הום q. v.), 28:20 (|| מִגְעֶרֶת מְאֵרָה, ); compare מ ׳יוֺם 1Sam 22:5 (|| מְבוּכָה מְבוּסָה, ) a day of discomfiture & down-treading & confusion .

occurrences.englishText: But Yahweh your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.

Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

It was so, that after they had carried it there, Yahweh’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.

They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.
Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion.
In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.
Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh,
For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”
Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
Those who are near, and those who are far from you, will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.
Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod,
It will happen in that day, that a great panic from Yahweh will be among them; and they will each hold onto the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.
